name: Coldwell Silo
scope: Original modular architecture and inert display art. Architectural massing and circulation reference, not an as-built reconstruction.

research.title: Titan II Missile Museum National Historic Landmark nomination
research.figure: Figure 3, side elevation and blast-lock plan, credited David K. Stumpf 1993; the long cableway is explicitly shortened.
research.inspection: Text and rendered figure inspected. Use textual cableway dimensions; do not scale the shortened diagram.
research.rights: Reference-only mixed-authorship PDF. Original PDF and page pixels are excluded from Git, runtime assets and delivery ZIP. No rights in those drawings are asserted.

dimensions.method: nominal between outer thresholds; native wall joining extensions separate
nominal between outer thresholds; native wall joining extensions separate

originalChoices: 1 m structural annulus gives a 15 m clear silo interior and 10 m clear capsule interior.
Eight equipment decks at indices 0,2,5,8,11,14,17,20; exact heights adapted to grid.
Three main capsule decks at 15,17,19; 4.24 m double intervals.
4 by 3 m repeated switchback stairs, 12 risers per 2.12 m; portal has 60 instead of the documented 55 risers.
9 by 9 m dogleg lock and 5 by 6 m access portal; room partitions, circulation and prop layouts original.
Service bridges, sliding cover, furniture, facade details and surface stair well are original game interpretations.
Native signed Y preserved. Deepest plate translated to nonnegative world h=0 using separate metadata.
Annular walls and clipped cells are explicit custom geometry; no invented exact collision AABBs.
